content:
The last **total solar eclipse** before the year 2000 occurred on **August 11, 1999**.

This eclipse was one of the most widely observed in history, with its path of totality crossing parts of **Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia**. The maximum duration of totality was **2 minutes and 23 seconds** near **Romania**.

If you're asking about **any type of solar eclipse** (partial, annular, or hybrid), the last one before 2000 was a **partial solar eclipse on December 25, 1999**, visible in parts of **Antarctica and the southern Indian Ocean**.

Would you like details on visibility or historical significance?
